prediction_order: Written before any live run; no live run has been requested or performed.
missing_observables: A collision-checked mesh content fingerprint shared by GR2 data and runtime BLAS source geometry
Object-space UV and native N/B/T basis for meshes without a G-buffer capture
A validated pak-material-to-native-row recipe and texture residency binding
An offline replay proving every previously qualified row and its evaluated energy unchanged

gates.qualified_share: Each ON diagnostic window must improve Q/A beyond the absolute OFF-b minus OFF-a repeat spread; no positive prediction is justified until the offline join succeeds.
gates.existing_qualified_rows: Zero changed bytes and zero changed evaluated values on the previously qualified subset; global scene mean is not a substitute.
gates.scene_energy: Float pre-post scene-colour mean in dumps.json, ON versus the mean of OFF-a and OFF-b; threshold comes from the OFF repeat spread. No PNG or bloom mean.
gates.gpu_cost: GI trace GPU median per cost window, ON minus mean OFF-a/OFF-b; diagnostics are disabled during cost windows.
gates.window_validity: At least 120 completed diagnostic frames per window, capacity overflow zero, scene wait timeout zero. Missing deciding lines make the run INVALID.
